predictions.articleTitle: Real Betis vs Barcelona Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Betis Stop Flick's Attack? — Scoreline & xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Barcelona's overwhelming 3.81 xG per game and superior squad quality will overcome Real Betis in an open, high-scoring Seville encounter.

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Barcelona seek ninth straight win against third-placed Real Betis in Seville.

spf.comment: Barcelona's historic 3.81 xG attacking output and complete domestic dominance make an away victory the clear primary projection.

over_under.comment: A massive combined xG expectation of 5.57 goals per game strongly supports clearing the 2.5 total line.

score.comment: Betis possess sufficient creative quality to register on the scoresheet, but Barcelona's volume creates decisive separation.

goals.comment: Both teams feature high-tempo attacking structures, pointing naturally to a match producing three to four goals.

bqc.comment: Betis should provide stern first-half resistance before Barcelona's attacking depth settles the contest after the interval.
